_comment: REAL captured medical-liaison adjudication envelope (S75, cfaj). The deployed medical-liaison, full profile inlined, adjudicated a held AUTHOR-DECLARED cross-domain conflict (the supplement-specialist flagged its fish-oil plan conflicts with the peptide-specialist's BPC-157 — additive bleeding risk) given an operator informed-refusal request. It assigned MEDIUM / H3 and built a content-valid override at the clear-choice rung. The orchestrator's adjudicate() validates this and RELEASES the conflict-held supplement: it records. This proves the S74 liaison gate generalizes to the conflict axis unchanged.

override_record.caution_verbatim: Author-declared cross-domain conflict from supplements: bpc-157 (peptides) — additive bleeding risk, needs review

risks_communicated.general: Fish oil 2 g/day (omega-3, mild antiplatelet effect) stacked with BPC-157 250 mcg subq (vascular-modulating/angiogenic) is an additive antithrombotic-class pairing on the safety watchlist. Neither is an anticoagulant prescription, but the combination raises bleeding/bruising risk above either alone.
risks_communicated.risks_of_proceeding: Proceeding raises the operator's risk of prolonged bleeding, easy/unusual bruising, nosebleeds, and harder-to-control bleeding during any cut, injury, dental work, or surgical/invasive procedure. Home monitoring detects but does not prevent a bleed; an unrecognized internal bleed can be serious. The interaction is real and additive, not eliminated by the operator's mitigation plan.

override_record.operator_reason: Operator accepts the additive bleeding/bruising risk for connective-tissue recovery, will hold both agents for 7 days before any procedure or dental work, will self-monitor for unusual bruising/nosebleeds/prolonged bleeding and stop plus seek care if they appear, and will disclose both to the primary-care doctor at the July 2026 visit.
override_record.override_literal: operator is overriding a safety block
override_record.voluntariness_note: Operator states the choice is made freely and without pressure, and explicitly acknowledges that home monitoring does not eliminate the risk. No clinical prescribing verdict is rendered; the pairing routes to the doctor at the July visit and to a database interaction lookup.
